For electronic components such as connectors and switches, the company designs and manufactures press dies, performs precision press processing, surface treatment such as precious metal plating, and insert molding. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥11,468 million. In addition to its head office (Kohoku Ward, Yokohama City), its locations include the Tohoku Division (Koriyama City, Fukushima Prefecture), the Hadano Press Technology Center (Hadano City, Kanagawa Prefecture), the Suzukawa Technology Center (Isehara City, Kanagawa Prefecture) and the Furukawa Plant (Osaki City, Miyagi Prefecture).
